credits_text: Starring Taarna Doherty & Paige Cathcart along with Thomas Trocken. Directed by Hu Ojpie. Writing and cinematography by Naale Hay. Produced by Thomas Trocken and assisted by Lu Harvey-Petterick Moss, Naale Manzi, Dana McShane and Joseph Salter.
